deferred_research_queue.focus: Fixed-amount US Community College & International UG Transfer Merit Awards
deferred_research_queue.research_objective: Verify concrete fixed/range award figures and transfer terms for JKCF Transfer, OAS Academic, CCPG, and state transfer articulation grants.
official_sources_required: UC / CSU / SUNY official transfer merit pages
deferred_research_queue.existing_evidence: Eligibility rules and program existence verified; CSS Profile full-need programs (MIT/Yale/Princeton/Stanford) confirmed variable.
deferred_research_queue.missing_evidence: Live award schedule from WAF-blocked (HTTP 403) sponsor portals; published fixed transfer grant caps separate from variable institutional aid.
deferred_research_queue.why_deferred: Current JKCF, OAS, and CCPG portals return HTTP 403 anti-bot challenges; automated bypass is disallowed so human browser verification is required.

deferred_research_queue.focus: Confirm transfer-student eligibility across 12 broad 'all' undergraduate scholarships
deferred_research_queue.research_objective: Verify explicit external transfer vs incoming first-year clauses across 12 national/institutional undergraduate scholarships.
official_sources_required: Paris-Saclay (FR), CHED TES (PH), VNU Hanoi (VN), PTDF (NG), KNB (ID), Polimi DSU (IT), MESCyT (DO)
deferred_research_queue.existing_evidence: Program existence, citizenship/residency/degree rules verified; general undergraduate wording only.
deferred_research_queue.missing_evidence: Explicit published transfer student clause permitting mid-degree external university transfers.
deferred_research_queue.why_deferred: Official pages establish undergraduate eligibility without stating whether external transfers from foreign or domestic institutions qualify.

deferred_research_queue.existing_evidence: Pearson (2026-11-08) and UBC (2026-11-15) previous cycle rules verified; McGill flagged conflicting_information; Melbourne HTTP 403.
deferred_research_queue.missing_evidence: Next 2027-2028 opening dates after Nov 2026 deadlines passed, McGill UG/Grad record separation, and Melbourne non-WAF fee schedule.
deferred_research_queue.why_deferred: Previous Nov 2026 cycles have closed, McGill remains conflicting, and Melbourne returns 403; requires human review.

deferred_research_queue.research_objective: Monitor official announcements for 2027/2028 application opening windows across closed calls and next_cycle_unannounced programs.
